title: Aerodrome Sign Inspection Checklist
description: Completed by Apron Supervisor or OM during weekly OCI. Electrical faults referred immediately to EEC per Annex 2-

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: Runway 07 designation sign at holding position -face intact, legend '07' correct, illuminated
Runway 25 designation sign at holding position- face intact, legend '25' correct, illuminated
All other mandatory holding position signs face intact, legends correct, illuminated
Critical area boundary sign (if applicable) intact and illuminated
No-entry signs present and legible at all applicable locations
All mandatory signposts upright, no visible corrosion or structural damage
All mandatory sign bases secure, no cracking of base plate or anchor

sections.title: LOCATION SIGNS (Yellow Text on Black Background)

items.text: Taxiway Alpha location sign 'A’ intact, legible, correct color
Taxiway Bravo location sign 'B’ intact, legible, correct color
Taxiway Charlie location sign 'C’ intact, legible, correct color

sections.title: DIRECTION SIGNS (Black Text on Yellow Background)

items.text: Direction signs at Taxiway Alpha / Runway intersection all arrows correct and legible
Direction signs at Taxiway Bravo / Runway intersection all arrows correct and legible
Direction signs at Taxiway Charlie / Runway intersection all arrows correct and legible
All direction signposts upright and structurally sound

sections.title: RUNWAY DISTANCE REMAINING SIGNS (White on Black)

items.text: All runway distance remaining signs present on both sides of runway (verify count per BCAR-14)
All numerals correct and legible
All distance remaining signs illuminated (night/low visibility check)
No sign face panels with water ingress (darkened, clouded, or moisture-fogged face)
No signs with missing letters, numbers, or arrows
No signs obscured by grass, weeds, or other vegetation
No signs with impact damage from vehicles or FOD
All sign mounting hardware intact (no missing bolts or loose fittings)
